# Line Led

**Carry › Line-Led** · v1.0.0 · 42 frames at 30 fps (20–80)

A line draws across the frame, then opens into a band that becomes the new scene as its edges travel out of frame.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/line-led@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Explainers and infographics
- Clean corporate edits
- Connecting two ideas

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import lineLed from './transitions/08-carry/line-led/line-led';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(lineLed, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 42 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | color | `"#FF4F1A"` |  | Colour of the leading element; use the incoming scene's background colour so it becomes the new background. |
| `thickness` | number | `10` | 2–30 | Line thickness in pixels. |
| `orientation` | enum | `"horizontal"` | `horizontal` · `vertical` | Direction the line draws. |
